landing.heroDesc: Yakha imikhuba yezimali enhle ngokusebenzisa ukuhlela isabelomali okuhlakaniphile, ukuhlela ukonga, kanye nesiqondiso esiqondile — konke kuhlelwe isimo sezimali saseNingizimu Afrika.

features.aiCoachDesc: Iseluleko esiqondile esisebenzisa i-AI eyazi isabelomali sakho, imigomo yokonga, nemikhuba yokusebenzisa imali
features.smartBudgetDesc: Landelela ukusebenzisa imali ngokwezigaba ngamabha okuqhubeka ngqo nezaziso zokusebenzisa ngokweqile
features.savingsGoalsDesc: Beka imigomo enomnqamulajuqu uthole izincomo ezihlakaniphile zokufinyelela kuzona ngokushesha
features.healthScoreDesc: Isikali esiguqukayo esibonisa imali engenayo, ukusebenzisa, izinga lokonga, nempilo yesikweletu

steps.step1Desc: Faka imali engenayo yakho wenze izigaba zokusebenzisa imali
steps.step2Desc: Bhala phansi izindleko ubeke imigomo yokonga enomnqamulajuqu
steps.step3Desc: Buza umqeqeshi wakho we-AI iseluleko sezimali esiqondile

landing.testimonial: I-MaliMind ingisizile ukonga u-R15,000 wesikhwama sami sezimo eziphuthumayo ezinyangeni ezine nje. Umqeqeshi we-AI ungigcina nginomthwalo ngendlela engazange yenzeke nge-app.

savings.title: Imigomo Yokonga
savings.noGoals: Awukabi nemigomo yokonga. Dala owakho wokuqala!

coach.title: Umqeqeshi Wezimali we-AI
coach.greeting: Sawubona! Ngingumqeqeshi wakho wezimali we-MaliMind AI. Ngiyakwazi ukubona isabelomali sakho, imigomo yokonga, nesikali sempilo yezimali — ngakho iseluleko sami siqondiswe esimweni sakho. Ungathanda ukusizwa ngani namuhla?
coach.limitReached: Usufike kumkhawulo wemilayezo yamahhala yansuku zonke. Thuthukela ku-Pro ukuze uthole ukuqeqeshwa okungenamkhawulo!
coach.error: Ngiyaxolisa, angikwazanga ukukuphendula lokho. Sicela uzame futhi.

suggestions.save: Ngingonga kanjani ngokwengeziwe ngemali engenayo yami?

premium.proDesc: Thokozela ukuqeqeshwa kwezimali kwe-AI okungenamkhawulo nezici eziphrimiyamu.
